title: Trinity Cognitive Probes - TEFB Track (MC Format)
subtitle: Executive Function Battery for AGI Assessment
description:
**Part of the DeepMind AGI Hackathon Submission**

The TEFB (Trinity Executive Function Battery) track in MC format evaluates cognitive control, working memory, task switching, and inhibition through multiple choice questions.

**Contains:**
- 1,805 MC questions
- Ground truth answers (A/B/C/D)
- Difficulty levels (u03c6-scaled)
- Brain zone metadata (dlPFC, vlPFC, ACC, etc.)
- Neural analog references

**Evaluation Metrics:**
- Accuracy: Binary correct/incorrect per item
- Calibration: How well model probabilities match actual correctness
- Composite: 60% accuracy + 20% calibration + 20% mean score

**Organization:** gHashTag/trinity
**License:** MIT
